paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is currently 3.17, with a change of 0.25% compared to the prior close and a change of -33.16% over a window of 23 sessions.

The recent news about Fermi Inc includes its partnership with AMD for credit support on its 222 MW Project Matador AI power campus in Texas, which was reported by sources such as Seeking Alpha and Benzinga on October 13.

There have been recent filings, including a notice of proposed sale filed on October 15 and October 14, and an 8-K filing on October 14, which disclosed that Fermi Inc has posted a fact sheet containing additional information regarding its lease with TensorWave at the Project Matador site to its website.
